title: Around higher-order Godbersen conjectures
summary: We consider two higher-order generalizations of the Godbersen conjecture for mixed volumes of convex bodies, which were first proposed by Schneider in 2000. First, we establish the conjectures in several special cases, in particular in low dimensions. Second, we prove that certain consequences of the conjectures hold. More precisely, we define a higher-order version of the unbalanced difference body and prove related weighted inequalities, generalizing previous results of Artstein-Avidan and Putterman.
